WeedPatch_Text_Npc0.fr: Les insectes grandissent vite.\nCapture-en deux de chaque,\lau cas où.
WeedPatch_Text_Npc0.en: Bugs grow fast. Catch two of each,\njust in case.

WeedPatch_Text_Npc1.fr: ARMULYS et BLINDALYS finissent tous\ndeux par voler.
WeedPatch_Text_Npc1.en: CASCOON and SILCOON both end up\nflying.

WeedPatch_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

WeedPatch_Text_Stay.fr: Prends ton temps. La marée peut\nattendre.
WeedPatch_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
